expected_output.reasoning:
The agent's response matches the expected output closely on all key substantive points: (1) correctly identifies eu-west-1 pricing per the deploy workflow; (2) notes the stack doesn't exist (topology check), implying $0.00 adjustment for existing resources; (3) correctly prices LedgerDb instance at 0.500 x 730 = $365.00, discarding the 0.000 UnusedBox reservation SKU; (4) correctly prices LedgerDb storage at 0.250 x 200 = $50.00; (5) correctly prices NAT gateway hours at 0.050 x 730 = $36.50; (6) correctly prices NAT EIP at 0.005 x 730 = $3.65; (7) correctly prices ALB hours at 0.025 x 730 = $18.25, correctly discarding the TS-trust-store row; (8) arrives at the same total of $473.40/mo as the expected 'fixed floor' (matching the primary accepted total exactly); (9) correctly flags ArchiveBucket, ReconcilerFunction, NAT data processing bytes, and ALB LCU-hours as usage-dependent/unquantifiable; (10) implicitly treats subnet group, security group, and IAM role as having no charge (not mentioned as cost items). The agent did not include the alternate +$480.70 figure for the second ALB public IP, but the expected output explicitly states 'either total is accepted,' so omitting it is fine since $473.40 is one of the accepted answers. All core requirements are met with correct math and correct SKU discarding logic.</reasoning>
